subject: Link in Rmd file with shiny components

messages.author: a2c316298c1ee632
messages.subject: Link in Rmd file with shiny components
parts:
So I have a file (index.Rmd) in a myapp directory in the /srv/shiny-server directory.

This runs the Rmd file dynamically like a mini shiny app at http://myurl.com:3838/myapp

What I can't figure out how to do is include a link to a static file in my .Rmd document.

I've tried just html code... <a href="data/data.csv">data.csv</a> but it says "NOT FOUND" The link resolves to http://myurl.com:3838/myapp/data/data.csv

I've tried the R way of generating that... `r library(shiny);a(file="data/data.csv", "data.csv")`

But neither work. Both ways work on my local machine, just not when I put it up on a server in /srv/shiny-server/myapp. 

Thank you

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Link in Rmd file with shiny components
parts:
Cory,

This is not currently supported. There are some security concerns around this. We will be looking into this for future releases.

Best,
Fereshteh

messages.subject: Re: Link in Rmd file with shiny components
parts: If you provide a full url to dropbox or some other host that has the file it should work. I used this approach to include images in a dynamic Rmd. It would indeed be great if local files could be included as you can with a non-dynamic Rmd.
